Our pour-over set pairs a hand-glazed ceramic dripper with a 600 ml carafe and two matching 200 ml cups. The dripper's spiral ribs keep the filter from sealing against the wall, so water flows evenly and you get a clean, bright cup in under four minutes.

  • Fits standard #2 cone filters
  • Dishwasher safe; not for stovetop use
  • Each piece is glazed by hand, so speckles vary
